result.topic_en: Euler begins Case III, an elastic rod free at one end E and clamped at the other end F, and applies the boundary conditions to derive equations for the ratio α/β that determine its regular vibrations.
result.transcription:
) 134 (

Euolutio caſus III.
quo alter terminos liber, alter vero muro firmiter
infixus ſtatuitur.

Problema.

§. 30. Si virga elaſtica in termino E fuerit libera, in altero autem termino F quaſi muro infixa, inueſtigare omnes vibrationes regulares, quibus ea contremiſcere poteſt.

Solutio.

Conditio ad terminum E pertinens ſtatim nobis praebet vt ante $\gamma = \alpha - \beta$ et $\delta = \alpha + \beta$; tum vero, poſito $s = a$ factoque $\frac{a}{f} = \omega$, debet eſſe tam $y = 0$, quam $\left(\frac{dy}{ds}\right) = 0$; vnde iſtas deducimus aequationes:
$\alpha e^{\omega} + \beta e^{-\omega} + \gamma \,\text{fin.}\, \omega + \delta \,\text{cof.}\, \omega = 0$ et
$\alpha e^{\omega} - \beta e^{-\omega} + \gamma \,\text{cof.}\, \omega - \delta \,\text{fin.}\, \omega = 0$,
in quibus ſi loco $\gamma$ et $\delta$ valores inuenti ſubſtituantur, prodibunt ſequentes:
$\alpha(e^{\omega} + \text{fin.}\, \omega + \text{cof.}\, \omega) + \beta(e^{-\omega} - \text{fin.}\, \omega + \text{cof.}\, \omega) = 0$ et
$\alpha(e^{\omega} + \text{cof.}\, \omega - \text{fin.}\, \omega) - \beta(e^{-\omega} + \text{cof.}\, \omega + \text{fin.}\, \omega) = 0$,
hincque duplici modo elicitur:
$\frac{\alpha}{\beta} = \frac{-e^{-\omega} + \text{fin.}\, \omega - \text{cof.}\, \omega}{e^{\omega} + \text{fin.}\, \omega + \text{cof.}\, \omega} = \frac{e^{-\omega} + \text{cof.}\, \omega + \text{fin.}\, \omega}{e^{\omega} + \text{cof.}\, \omega - \text{fin.}\, \omega}$.
Ponatur iterum, vti hactenus fecimus, $\text{fin.}\, \omega + \text{cof.}\, \omega = p$ et $\text{fin.}\, \omega - \text{cof.}\, \omega = g$, vt habeamus
$\frac{-e^{-\omega} + q}{e^{\omega} + p} = \frac{e^{-\omega} + p}{e^{\omega} - q}$,

cuius

items.quote: Si virga elaſtica in termino E fuerit libera, in altero autem termino F quaſi muro infixa, inueſtigare omnes vibrationes regulares, quibus ea contremiſcere poteſt.
items.english: If an elastic rod is free at the end E, but at the other end F is as if fixed into a wall, to investigate all the regular vibrations with which it can vibrate.
